looks.reason: OLED black background pairs with vibrant glowing pink highlights for an immersive midnight video viewing experience.
Puts short video media and member content front and center with minimal decorative distractions.

requested.words: bold and playful, dark background, a hot pink accent

design.reason: A short-video feed requires immersive portrait-oriented media cards, effortless interaction touchpoints, and dedicated moderation controls.

tours.name: Post a clip
tours.outcome: A short video clip is published to the feed and appears on the creator profile

steps.title: Upload clip with caption (the clip becomes published). Rule: Clip must include valid video content and a caption
Display clip on creator profile (the profile becomes updated)

tours.name: Engage with content
tours.outcome: Feedback is recorded on the clip and the clip author is notified

steps.title: Like or comment on clip (the clip becomes engaged). Rule: Member can like once per clip
Notify clip author (the notification becomes sent)

tours.name: Follow a creator
tours.outcome: The member follows the creator and follow counts are updated

steps.title: Follow creator (the profile becomes following). Rule: Cannot follow oneself
Notify followed creator (the notification becomes sent)

tours.name: Report and moderate content
tours.outcome: Violating content is hidden from the community

steps.title: Report clip or comment (the report becomes pending). Rule: Reported item must exist
Hide violating content (the clip becomes hidden). Rule: Only content breaking rules may be hidden
